title: Track verification cost, catches, false positives and escapes in status
summary: Add a "verification" section to `athena status` computed from existing verification, job and revert/intervention records: verifier cost, rejections caught, false positives (rejections later overruled), and escapes (landed jobs later reverted or fixed). Register the label and set OLY-B-A7-04's mechanism and measure to `status: verification`. Audience: Apollo and the owner reading status.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria require new tests plus fmt, clippy, test.
Criteria check rendered status output and counts.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/status.rs (STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS at ~305, MistakeReport and mistake_report at ~584, StatusView built at ~1321), crates/athena-core/src/status/planning.rs (keep rule, later-harm pattern to reuse), crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs (status() at 1258, mistakes() at 512), crates/athena-data/src/records.rs (Verification with agent_verdict/final_verdict/findings, CheckRun, Totals.cost_execution, Finding). Entry point is Status::status() building StatusView, rendered by display::status. No new record or data file under crates/ is added, so check_record_file/AnyRecord/round-trip need no change; records are only read.

Existing code: extend crates/athena-core/src/status.rs, crates/athena-core/src/status/planning.rs (later-harm logic) and crates/athena-data/src/records.rs types; docs/spec.toml existing label convention. Reuse the later-harm/revert detection rather than building a second one.

Definitions: caught = verification with final_verdict rejecting; false positive = a rejection later overruled or whose job landed by the owner/retry unchanged (best available from records, labelled as such); escaped = landed job later cited as a revert or fix. If a figure cannot be derived from records, the line says so rather than showing a guess.
Governance: athena.toml, defaults.toml and workflows are not changed; no Consumers entry needed.
Not a refusal rule, so no refusal-rate criterion applies.

acceptance_criteria.text: In docs/spec.toml, OLY-B-A7-04 has a `mechanism` naming the verification report code in crates/athena-core/src/status (not "none"), keeps owner "Apollo", and a `measure` ending with `status: verification`. Check with Grep on docs/spec.toml.

STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS in crates/athena-core/src/status.rs contains the label ("verification", "verification") mapped to a new StatusView field, and crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs prints a line starting with `verification` from that field. Check with Grep.

A unit test in crates/athena-core builds Records with verifications (rejected and passed), job totals, an overruled rejection and a landed job later reverted, and asserts the report counts total verifier cost, rejections caught, false positives and escapes. The test fails when the computation is stubbed out and passes with it. Run `cargo test`.

A test in crates/athena-cli/tests renders `athena_cli::display::status` and asserts the output contains a line starting with `verification` showing cost, caught, false positives and escaped counts. Run `cargo test`.
With empty Records, a test asserts the verification line contains the text `none yet` and no `0` counts shown as success (no-empty-success). Run `cargo test`.
The xtask spec test accepts the new measure marker and label. Run `cargo test` (covers xtask).
fmt, clippy and test pass: run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy`, `cargo test`.
CHANGELOG.md has an added entry for this change; no existing entry of docs/decisions.md or anything under records/ is edited.

out_of_scope: Changing verifier behavior, verdict rules or gates
Editing existing records/ or docs/decisions.md entries
departures: Slightly higher cost than reference: new status section across core, cli and spec with derived metrics.
